text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Run a blind A/B test of **Claude Mythos 5** vs **Fable 5** on a 2% slice of EXCAVA’s pipeline. Mythos 5’s documented 0.5%+ edge in reasoning tasks makes it the highest-leverage upgrade available right now. The trade-off is the 2% slice’s risk—if Mythos 5 underperforms, we lose minimal throughput, but if it wins, we scale it immediately. No other single change offers this upside with this low downside.

name: Torque
text: Risk: Mythos 5’s edge is unproven in EXCAVA’s pipeline—Fable 5 already runs stable on full data, so a 2% slice may not reflect EXCAVA’s full distribution. Better alternative: test Mythos 5 on a 10% slice with a kill-switch if quality drops 0.3% below baseline—this balances risk and captures more of the real distribution. Settle it with a 48-hour head-to-head on live traffic, metrics locked before the test.

name: Gearbox
text:
Run a blind A/B test of **Claude Mythos 5** vs **Fable 5** on a 10% slice of EXCAVA’s pipeline. Mythos 5’s documented reasoning edge justifies the larger slice—we need real-world data, not a toy sample. The trade-off is accepting a 0.3% quality drop risk for a faster, more reliable verdict than a 2% slice could ever give. If Mythos 5 underperforms, the kill-switch cuts losses; if it wins, we scale it to full data without second-guessing.

name: Torque
text: Risk: A 10% slice still risks skewing EXCAVA’s distribution—Mythos 5’s edge may vanish on edge cases outside the slice. Better alternative: run a 5% slice with a 0.2% kill-switch, paired with a stress test on the top 1% of low-confidence outputs from the full pipeline—this exposes Mythos 5’s weakness where it matters most. Settle it: if the stress test shows no drop, Mythos 5 gets a full rollout; if it fails, Fable 5 stays.
